queries.label: Patients per ward
queries.query: SELECT wardid, COUNT(*) FROM patient GROUP BY wardid ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 10;

queries.label: Distinct diagnosis + hospital
queries.query: SELECT DISTINCT hospitalid, diagnosisstring FROM diagnosis JOIN patient USING (patientunitstayid) LIMIT 20;

queries.label: Median admission age (approximation)
queries.query: SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY CAST(age AS INTEGER)) FROM patient WHERE age ~ '^[0-9]+$';

queries.label: Gender-disaggregated lab result averages
queries.query: SELECT p.gender, l.labname, AVG(CAST(l.labresult AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) AS avg_result FROM patient p JOIN lab l ON p.patientunitstayid = l.patientunitstayid WHERE l.labresult ~ '^[0-9.]+$' GROUP BY p.gender, l.labname LIMIT 20;

queries.label: Max lab result per patient
queries.query: SELECT patientunitstayid, MAX(CAST(labresult AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) FROM lab WHERE labresult ~ '^[0-9.]+$' GROUP BY patientunitstayid ORDER BY MAX(CAST(labresult AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) DESC LIMIT 10;

queries.label: Diagnoses linked to lab test frequency
queries.query: SELECT d.diagnosisstring, COUNT(*) AS lab_tests FROM diagnosis d JOIN lab l ON d.patientunitstayid = l.patientunitstayid GROUP BY d.diagnosisstring ORDER BY lab_tests DESC LIMIT 10;

queries.label: Vitals timeline preview
queries.query: SELECT p.patientunitstayid, v.observationoffset, v.heartrate, v.temperature FROM patient p JOIN vitalperiodic v ON p.patientunitstayid = v.patientunitstayid WHERE v.observationoffset BETWEEN 0 AND 1000 ORDER BY v.observationoffset ASC LIMIT 50;

queries.label: Long-running join query
queries.query: SELECT p.patientunitstayid, COUNT(v.heartrate) FROM patient p JOIN vitalperiodic v ON p.patientunitstayid = v.patientunitstayid GROUP BY p.patientunitstayid ORDER BY COUNT(v.heartrate) DESC LIMIT 20;

queries.label: Highly connected patients
queries.query: SELECT p.patientunitstayid, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vitalperiodic v WHERE v.patientunitstayid = p.patientunitstayid) AS vitals, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM diagnosis d WHERE d.patientunitstayid = p.patientunitstayid) AS dx, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lab l WHERE l.patientunitstayid = p.patientunitstayid) AS labs FROM patient p ORDER BY (vitals + dx + labs) DESC LIMIT 10;

queries.label: Full lifecycle note
setup: INSERT INTO note (patientunitstayid, notetext) VALUES (8888888, 'Initial note');
query_seq: UPDATE note SET notetext = 'Updated note' WHERE patientunitstayid = 8888888;

queries.label: Deleting Most Recent Lab Entry
setup: INSERT INTO lab (patientunitstayid, labname, labresult, labresultoffset) VALUES (9999999, 'Hb', '13.2', 100);
INSERT INTO lab (patientunitstayid, labname, labresult, labresultoffset) VALUES (9999999, 'Hb', '13.1', 200);
query_seq: DELETE FROM lab WHERE labresultoffset = (SELECT MAX(labresultoffset) FROM lab WHERE patientunitstayid = 9999999);

queries.label: Concurrent Vitals Correction Passes
setup: INSERT INTO vitalperiodic (patientunitstayid, observationoffset, heartrate) VALUES (8888888, 0, 85);
query_seq: UPDATE vitalperiodic SET heartrate = heartrate + 1 WHERE patientunitstayid = 8888888;
UPDATE vitalperiodic SET heartrate = heartrate - 1 WHERE patientunitstayid = 8888888;

queries.label: Synchronizing Room Assignments
setup: INSERT INTO patient (patientunitstayid, age, gender, hospitalid, unittype) VALUES (8888888, '60', 'Female', 4, 'Stepdown');
query_seq: UPDATE patient SET unittype = 'ICU' WHERE patientunitstayid = 8888888;
UPDATE patient SET unittype = 'Stepdown' WHERE patientunitstayid = 8888888;

queries.label: Deleting Most Recent Vital Entry
setup: INSERT INTO vitalperiodic (patientunitstayid, observationoffset, heartrate) VALUES (9999999, 100, 70);
INSERT INTO vitalperiodic (patientunitstayid, observationoffset, heartrate) VALUES (9999999, 200, 72);
query_seq: DELETE FROM vitalperiodic WHERE observationoffset = (SELECT MAX(observationoffset) FROM vitalperiodic WHERE patientunitstayid = 9999999);
